info.title: OCR + ID detection
info.description: Local, privacy-first text extraction (Arabic/English) and identity-document detection. All `/v1` endpoints need the `X-Api-Key` header. Every error has the shape `{"error": {"code", "message", "requestId"}}`; send `X-Request-Id` to correlate.

post.summary: Upload a document (PDF, DOCX, JPG, PNG, WEBP, TIFF) for text extraction + ID detection (async job)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Retry-safe uploads: the same key returns the same job (within RESULT_TTL_S)
schema.title: Idempotency-Key

parameters.description: Retry-safe uploads: the same key returns the same job (within RESULT_TTL_S)

post.summary: Extract text only (no ID detection, no LLM) and return it in the response
post.description: Synchronous: the request waits for OCR (about 2-3 s per scanned page on CPU). Arabic, English and mixed documents. At most `EXTRACT_MAX_PAGES` pages; use `/v1/documents` for larger files. The file is processed in memory only.

post.summary: Experimental: read handwritten text (Arabic first, English too) and return it
post.description: Synchronous and slow (on CPU about a minute or more per page). Images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, TIFF) and PDFs, every page rendered; at most `HANDWRITING_MAX_PAGES` pages. One request at a time (503 `busy` otherwise). Pages without ink are skipped, not sent to the model. `confidence` is always null: the model gives no calibrated confidence. Separate from `/v1/extract`, and may change while it is evaluated. The file is processed in memory only. `model` picks one of the server's handwriting models (`GET /health/handwriting` lists them; 400 `unknown_model` otherwise), `segmenter` how pages are split for it: `whole_page` (one call per page, also for an image that is already a single line) or `lines` (one call per detected text line).

get.summary: Job status, and the result when done
get.description: With `wait=N` (seconds, at most MAX_WAIT_S) the request is held until the job is done or failed, or N seconds pass (long-polling: no client-side polling loop needed).

delete.summary: Delete a job and its result now

get.summary: Full status: 503 unless OCR models are present AND the text LLM is available
Liveness: the process is up (for restarts by an orchestrator)
Readiness: OCR models present and the job worker running (for load balancers). The LLM is reported but not required, because /v1/extract works without it.
Experimental: status of the handwriting model (enabled, installed, downloaded, loaded or reachable). Not part of /health or /health/ready

includeBoxes.title: Includeboxes

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Processing profile: one of your client's (default: its first). Changes processing, output and retention; see `processing.profile`

normalizedText.title: Normalizedtext
normalizedText.description: Arabic-normalized text, for search and matching

timingsMs.title: Timingsms
timingsMs.description: Milliseconds per stage, e.g. extract, ocr, llm, vision, total (ocrPages: number of OCR'd pages); keys depend on the stages run

ExtractResult.title: ExtractResult
ExtractResult.description: Text-only result. `languages` lists `ar`/`en` by amount of text.

mimeType.title: Mimetype
mimeType.description: Detected from the content (magic bytes), never from the name

id.title: Id
id.description: The model's id on this server, when several are configured

name.title: Name
name.description: The model (Hugging Face id, local folder or served name)

adapter.title: Adapter
adapter.description: LoRA adapter applied on top of the model, if any

device.title: Device
device.description: cpu / cuda for the transformers backend; null for openai

maxPixels.title: Maxpixels
maxPixels.description: Largest image size the model saw (pixels)

segmenter.title: Segmenter
segmenter.description: How pages were split for the model: whole_page (one call per page) or lines (one call per detected text line)

text.title: Text
text.description: As the model read it: only line endings and surrounding whitespace are tidied

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Always null: the model gives no calibrated confidence, and none is made up

skipped.title: Skipped
skipped.description: blank: the page has (almost) no ink, so it was not sent to the model

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: truncated: the output hit HANDWRITING_MAX_NEW_TOKENS; repetition_loop: the output repeats itself (a decoding loop); no_lines: the lines segmenter found no text line on a page with ink; too_many_lines: only the first HANDWRITING_MAX_LINES lines were read. Review such pages

fullText.title: Fulltext
fullText.description: All pages' text, blank pages left out

HandwritingResult.title: HandwritingResult
HandwritingResult.description: Experimental handwriting OCR result. `languages` lists `ar`/`en` by amount of text.

decidedBy.title: Decidedby
decidedBy.description: The stages that took part, in order

mrz.description: Present when an MRZ with at most one failed check digit was found

code.title: Code
code.description: Stable error code (see the error table); program against it

JobView.title: JobView
JobView.description:
`status` queued/processing/done/failed. When done, the result fields are included; when failed, `error`.
`webhook` is present when a callbackUrl was given.

bbox.title: Bbox
bbox.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] as fractions (0-1) of the page, origin top-left

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: ICAO check digit per field, e.g. documentNumber, birthDate, expiryDate, personalNumber, composite

namesSource.title: Namessource
namesSource.description: mrz+text: names were completed from the printed text

Mrz.title: Mrz
Mrz.description:
Parsed machine-readable zone. Personal data. Rely on a field only when its `checks` entry is true; names carry
no check digit.

method.title: Method
method.description: text_layer: taken from the PDF/DOCX; ocr: recognized

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Average OCR confidence 0-1; null for text_layer pages

width.title: Width
width.description: OCR pages with includeBoxes: pixel width of the OCR'd image

height.title: Height
height.description: OCR pages with includeBoxes: pixel height of the OCR'd image

lines.title: Lines
lines.description: OCR pages with includeBoxes: lines in reading order

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: The processing profile (`default`: the global settings)

withheld.title: Withheld
withheld.description: Left out by the profile (data minimization): `text` = pages[].text, fullText, normalizedText and lines are empty and the AI models' reasons are removed; `mrz` = no idDetection.mrz. Withheld data is not stored either.

Processing.title: Processing
Processing.description:
What produced this result, for audits: the service version, the processing profile, and the OCR models, rules
file version (start of its SHA-256) and LLMs that were actually used. A part that wasn't used is left out.
